about: Product Description: Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold on consoles...
Single Player: Story Mode Play as Tanjiro and relive the Entertainment District Arc, the Swordsmith Village Arc, and the Hashira Training Arc from the TV anime, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba!
Battle Upper Rank demons with your allies!
The game features over 40 characters, including the nine Hashira, the highest-ranking swordsmen of the Demon Slayer Corps!
summary: Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
